style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

subtitles.zh: 你大幅超配银行，对保险则中性。谈谈背后的思路。我认为大背景是，我们正看到相当显著且前所未有的情况：美国利率与中国利率走势分化。
subtitles.en: You've owned way in the banks. You neutralize the insurers. Tell us a little more about the thinking behind that. Well, I think the big picture here is that we are seeing a pretty significant and quite unprecedented situation where US rates

subtitles.zh: 所以提到美国10年期国债收益率现在约在5%以上。
subtitles.en: are diverging. So you talk about 10-year bond news in the US now above around 5 percent.

subtitles.zh: 但同时，中国10年期国债收益率现在在1.6%。
subtitles.en: But at the same time, Chinese bond news, 10-year bond news, and now at 1.6.

subtitles.zh: 而两者利差超过3.5个百分点，历史上从未见过。
subtitles.en: And the UGAPs is above 3.5 percentage point. We've never seen that before in history.

subtitles.zh: 在此背景下，我们认为这主要反映了几个因素。
subtitles.en: So against the backdrop, we think that essentially that reflects a few things.

subtitles.zh: 第一，全球两大经济体在增长和通胀预期上的差异。
subtitles.en: Number one is the growth and inflation expectations, differentials between the two major economies in the world.

subtitles.zh: 将其转化为权益市场策略，我们认为银行表现应会不错。
subtitles.en: And when you translate that into equity market strategy, we think that banks should do well.

subtitles.zh: 尤其是香港上市的中资银行。原因一：美国利率高企时，人们寻求价值。
subtitles.en: Particularly Hong Kong listed Chinese banks. The reasons are number one. When rates are high in the US, people look for value.

subtitles.zh: 在香港寻找股息机会，银行显然应受益。
subtitles.en: Look for dividend plays in Hong Kong. And obviously banks should benefit.

subtitles.zh: 同时，内地利率1.6%意味着内地市场股权风险溢价仍处高位。
subtitles.en: And at the same time, when you look at onshore rates, 1.6 percent, that implies that equity risk premium remains very elevated in the onshore market.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为这可能会为短久期权益资产和银行板块提供一定支撑，而银行也属于这一类别。
subtitles.en: And we think that we'll likely provide some support for short-duration equities and banks with fit into that category.

briefs.speaker: Kendra Lau
briefs.speaker_context: Chief China equity strategist at Goldman Sachs
briefs.current_title: 高盛Kendra Lau：盈利拐点已现，市场为何不买账？

subtitles.zh: 我们认为这可能为短久期权益资产和银行板块提供一定支撑。您能否解释一下，鉴于报告提到我们正接近盈利拐点。
subtitles.en: And we think that we'll likely provide some support for short-duration equities and banks with fit into that category. Can you explain why is it that, given you said in your report, we are closed to this earnings inflection point.

subtitles.zh: 您提到第二季度有20%的涨幅，是五年来的最高水平。
subtitles.en: I mean, second quarter, you mentioned, is 20 percent gain, which is the highest in five years.

subtitles.zh: 而我们刚看到的工业企业利润数据也出现了较大幅度跃升。
subtitles.en: And we just got the industrial profit numbers, which is quite a big jump.

subtitles.zh: 是的，我们持续看到市场反应与数据似乎有些脱节。
subtitles.en: And yes, we continue to see the market reaction, looking pretty like last, but there seems to be a disconnect there.

subtitles.zh: 这是怎么回事？如果看市场内部结构，本质上银行、现金回报主题和股息策略表现不错。
subtitles.en: What is going on? I mean, if you look at the internal of the markets, essentially again, banks, or cash return themes, dividends, they've done well.

subtitles.zh: 但明显承压的领域是权益市场中与AI相关的部分。
subtitles.en: But the areas that are seeing some pressure, obviously, is the AI part of the economy in the equity market.

subtitles.zh: 正如我们与Yvonne讨论时，我提出了那个问题。
subtitles.en: And I think, as we discussed with Yvonne, I asked that question.

subtitles.zh: 我认为目前全球beta对AI科技板块仍是拖累。
subtitles.en: I think the global beta remains a drag for the AI tech for now.

subtitles.zh: 所以退一步看，如果观察综合指数，目前估值已回到非常有吸引力的水平。
subtitles.en: So when you kind of take a step back, if you look at the aggregate index, right now, valuations are back to very attractive levels.

subtitles.zh: 正如您提到的，国家队正在加大力度、介入市场，对吗？
subtitles.en: As you mentioned, that the national team is stepping up, stepping in, right?

subtitles.zh: 据我们估算，仅过去两周，国家队净买入约2000亿港元的亚洲权益资产。
subtitles.en: And on our estimate, just in the past two weeks, national team has net bought about 200 billion worth of Asia equities.

subtitles.zh: 因此我们认为，短期内流动性和情绪可能获得支撑，Alice。
subtitles.en: So we think that we're likely to pull a floor, Alice, in the short term, when it comes to liquidity and sentiment.

briefs.speaker: Kendra Lau
briefs.speaker_context: Chief China equity strategist at Goldman Sachs
briefs.current_title: 高盛Kendra Lau：AI组合大调整，硬件之后应用接棒？

subtitles.zh: 所以，Alice，我们认为短期内流动性和情绪可能见底。你也更新了中国精选AI组合。
subtitles.en: So we think that we're likely to pull a floor, Alice, in the short term, when it comes to liquidity and sentiment. You also refreshed your China Select AI portfolio.

subtitles.zh: 你是怎么更新的？硬件还是重要主题吗？那个组合里？
subtitles.en: How did you refresh it? Is hardware still a big theme? Isn't that portfolio?

subtitles.zh: 我觉得关键词其实是多元化。
subtitles.en: I think the key word here is really diversification.

subtitles.zh: 很抱歉这么说，但我听了Anthony刚才讲的中国AI生态加速发展。
subtitles.en: Sorry to say that, but I listened to what Anthony just talked about in terms of the Chinese AI ecosystem ramping up.

subtitles.zh: 所以在我们几周前发布的一份报告中，我们确实试图强调这个主题。
subtitles.en: So in a report that we put out a few weeks ago, essentially, we really tried to emphasize on that subject.

subtitles.zh: 我认为全球AI共识的叙事肯定在市场参与者中越来越有吸引力。
subtitles.en: I think the narrative of a global AI deal openly is definitely gaining traction among investors.

subtitles.zh: 所以当你审视中国AI生态时，实际上有两个部分。
subtitles.en: So when you look at the Chinese AI ecosystem, actually, there are two parts of the ecosystem.

subtitles.zh: 一部分更偏向出口导向。也就是中国AI公司把产品出口到西方，对吧？
subtitles.en: One is more export oriented. So Chinese AI companies that are exporting the products to the West, right?

subtitles.zh: 所以它们基本上是美国资本开支繁荣的衍生品。
subtitles.en: So they're basically derivatives of the CapEx boom in the US.

subtitles.zh: 但同时，另一个主要部分是中国AI公司主要服务内地市场。
subtitles.en: But at the same time, the other major part of the picture is really the Chinese AI companies primarily serving the domestic market.

subtitles.zh: 他们对外出口并不多，业务主要在国内。
subtitles.en: They don't really export that much to the world, but they really do their business on shore.

subtitles.zh: 因此我们构建了两个不同的组合，帮助市场参与者更好地布局未来这一趋势。
subtitles.en: So that's why we create two different baskets to help investors better position for that development in the future.

subtitles.zh: 我们仍看好出口型企业，但同时，如果市场参与者想把握AI生态内更独特的机会，
subtitles.en: So we still like the exporters, but at the same time, I think if investors want to really trade for the more idiosyncratic opportunities within the AI ecosystem,

subtitles.zh: 我认为本土企业将从中受益。
subtitles.en: I think the domestic names would benefit that.

briefs.speaker: Kendra Lau
briefs.speaker_context: Chief China equity strategist at Goldman Sachs
briefs.current_title: 高盛Kendra Lau：中美AI路径分化，中国应用端机会在哪？

subtitles.zh: 那同行AI表现如何？它们受到较大冲击，对吧？
subtitles.en: What about the peer play AI? They've been hit quite hard, right?

subtitles.zh: 因为它们在技术上不如美国先进。
subtitles.en: Because they're not as technology advanced as the US.

subtitles.zh: 你还有像DeepSeek这样的公司似乎仍在领跑，但它们尚未上市。
subtitles.en: You still have the likes of deep-seek that seem to be still leading the charge that are not listed companies yet.

subtitles.zh: 这就让像智谱、MiniMax这样的公司处于一种悬而未决的状态。
subtitles.en: And that really kind of leaves the likes of Jirupu, the likes of Mini Max, and kind of a limbo there.

subtitles.zh: 它们只是有点落后。我该如何看待同行表现？
subtitles.en: They're just kind of just dragging behind me. How should I look at peer plays?

subtitles.zh: 我会说我们看看美国。
subtitles.en: I would say we look at the US.

subtitles.zh: 我认为基本上，美国和中国在发展AI方面采取了非常不同的方式。
subtitles.en: I think basically, US and China are taking very different approaches when it comes to developing AI.

subtitles.zh: 显然，在美国，这更像是一种高成本、高回报的模式。
subtitles.en: Obviously, in the US, it's more like a high cost and properly high return model.

subtitles.zh: 例如，其他领先公司正试图创造AGI、ASI。
subtitles.en: For example, again, other leading companies are trying to create AGI ASI.

subtitles.zh: 但对中国来说，我认为AI被视为一种公共产品。
subtitles.en: But for China, I think AI is perceived or regarded as a public good.

subtitles.zh: 这就是为什么我们有开源模型、开放权重模型。
subtitles.en: That's why we have open source model, open weight model.

subtitles.zh: 你基本上不是靠收取高利润率来赚钱。
subtitles.en: You don't make money basically charging very high margins.

subtitles.zh: 而是靠规模来赚钱。
subtitles.en: But you make money from volume.

subtitles.zh: 所以每当政策制定者谈到人工智能时，都会带一个加号。
subtitles.en: So when it comes to trying that every time policymakers talk about AI, it comes with a plus.

subtitles.zh: 就是人工智能加应用。
subtitles.en: It's AI plus application.

subtitles.zh: 所以这就是为什么在我们的报告中，我们真正试图强调，除了硬件板块，我们认为应用可能是发展方向。
subtitles.en: So that's why in our report, we really try to emphasize, besides the hardware cohorts, we think that applications could be the way to go.

You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
- Title fields must not use financial-advice or product-sale wording such as 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出. Rephrase with neutral market wording such as 资管、配置、权益资产、市场、产品、财富配置、保障、观点.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

subtitles.zh: 我们看到它非常契合AI周期。欧洲则稍显吃力。
subtitles.en: We can see it fits very well into the AI cycle. Europe struggles a bit more.

subtitles.zh: 但我们也开始看到，整体信贷利差出现了一些代价。
subtitles.en: But we also can start to see that there's some tolls now on credit spreads overall.

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，美国高收益利差达到年内最阔水平。
subtitles.en: I mean, U.S. high yield spreads are that widest for the year.

subtitles.zh: 这可能也与为整个AI**提供资金所需的部分融资有关。
subtitles.en: And it's probably also related on some of the funding that it's needed to basically finance the whole AI investments.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们开始看到一些裂痕出现，或者对其可持续性、能持续多久存在问号。
subtitles.en: And so, we start to see that there's some cracks coming up and or question marks on how sustainable it is, how long it can go.

subtitles.zh: 但总体而言，我们仍对该主题非常乐观。
subtitles.en: But overall, we still remain very positive on the topic.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我认为还有更多上行空间。

briefs.current_title: 瑞银Adrian：融资成本上升，AI交易最大隐患？

subtitles.zh: 您认为融资成本上升是否仍会对AI交易构成某种压力？
subtitles.en: Do you think that when it comes to higher financing costs, is that going to be still some sort of overhang when it comes to the AI trade?

subtitles.zh: 目前这些公司根本不在意多发50个基点。
subtitles.en: Well, at the moment, these companies, they just don't care if they issue at 50 base points more.

subtitles.zh: 这也开始对政府债券产生一定的挤出效应。
subtitles.en: And we started a little bit of a crowding out also for government bonds.

subtitles.zh: 因此对超额利差产生了影响。
subtitles.en: And so it had an impact on overrun spreads.

subtitles.zh: 也对超额利率产生了影响。现在，作为多资产类别市场参与者，当利率和债券开始真正显得有吸引力时，
subtitles.en: And it had an impact overrun rates. Now, as a multi-asset class investor, after, say, rates and bonds really start to look attractive,

subtitles.zh: 一个优质债券组合的年化收益率可能达到6%。
subtitles.en: you get probably 6% per annum yield on a good quality bond portfolio.

subtitles.zh: 这是简单的数学。如果以6%的收益率**五年，平均而言，通常每年至少能获得6%的回报。
subtitles.en: And it's just simple math. If you invest at the yield of six in five years in average, usually you will probably clock in at least 6% return per annum.

subtitles.zh: 考虑到所承担的风险水平，这相当有吸引力。
subtitles.en: And that's quite attractive for the risk level you take.

subtitles.zh: 当然，短期来看，我们仍认为权益资产还有一定上行空间。
subtitles.en: Short term, of course, we still think equities have a bit more upside.

subtitles.zh: 但如果以10年为基准来看，我们刚刚做了相关研究。
subtitles.en: But if you look on a 10-year basis, we just did our research there.

subtitles.zh: 债券表现实际上优于权益资产。
subtitles.en: Bonds are actually outperforming equities.

subtitles.zh: 一旦权益风险溢价归零，优质**级组合收益率达到6%至6.5%左右。
subtitles.en: Once you have sort of a equities risk premium at zero, once you have yielded around six at six and a half on a good investment grade portfolio.

subtitles.zh: 因此，权益资产或债券的长期逻辑受到一定影响。
subtitles.en: So the long-term case for equities or bonds has been a bit more compromised.

subtitles.zh: 但短期来看，我认为两者都有不错的上行空间。
subtitles.en: But short term, I think both have a nice upside now.

subtitles.en: How constructive are you in Chinese tech?

briefs.current_title: 瑞银Adrian：中国科技估值诱人，但催化剂在哪？

subtitles.zh: 你对中国科技板块有多乐观？因为Cambricorn要发布财报，还有CXMT。
subtitles.en: How constructive are you in Chinese tech? Because we have Cambricorn releasing earnings, misestimates, CXMT.

subtitles.zh: 这是增长季度，预计环比也持平。
subtitles.en: It's growth quarter and quarter expected to remain flat as well.

subtitles.zh: 那么你认为有潜力吗？有理由持有中国科技股吗？
subtitles.en: So do you see any potential, any reason to hold Chinese tech?

subtitles.zh: 理由是估值。但我们现在对中国科技板块也更谨慎一些。
subtitles.en: The reason is valuation. But we also have been a bit more cautious now on Chinese tech.

subtitles.zh: 而且，中国整体增长面临压力。
subtitles.en: And look, Chinese is struggling in terms of growth overall.

subtitles.zh: **周期相当疲弱。我的意思是，出口是唯一真正有效的。
subtitles.en: Investment cycle is quite weak. I mean, the export is the one thing that really works.

subtitles.zh: 但这些**大多是国内的。
subtitles.en: But most of these investments are really domestic.

subtitles.zh: 我认为人工智能能力方面有很好的故事，但还没有体现出来。
subtitles.en: And I think there's a very good story around AI capabilities, but it's sort of not coming through.

subtitles.zh: 需要催化剂来释放这一点。目前很难看到这个催化剂。
subtitles.en: And it's a catalyst to unlock that. And it's very hard to see at the moment this catalyst.

subtitles.zh: 所以如果你有较长远的眼光，是的，配置一些中国人工智能资产是好的。
subtitles.en: So if you have a bit of a longer-term vision, yeah, it's good to have some Chinese AI exposure.

subtitles.zh: 但作为战术性交易，目前可能还不够。
subtitles.en: But for a tactical trade, it probably at the moment not enough.

subtitles.zh: 那么催化剂会是什么？
subtitles.en: What's going to be that catalyst, though?

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Forbidden hard-negative wording: 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not use sensitive geopolitical or military subjects, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbered prefixes.
- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

subtitles.en: What's going to be that catalyst, though? I wonder. Well, they probably caught, I mean, first of all, China has to do well again.

subtitles.zh: 而要表现良好，我们必须看到消费者信心回升。
subtitles.en: And to do it well, we have to see that consumer confidence coming back.

subtitles.zh: 消费者信心会在房地产周期转向后回升。
subtitles.en: And consumer confidence coming back once the real estate cycle is turning.

subtitles.zh: 中国消费者80%的财富困在房地产中，而且可能意外下降。
subtitles.en: And 80% of the wealth of Chinese consumers is trapped in properties and probably surprised decline.

subtitles.zh: 所以很难形成这种正向反馈循环。
subtitles.en: So it's very difficult to create this positive feedback loop.

subtitles.zh: 当然，这对一些AI相关公司有影响，它们的收入非常依赖国内市场。
subtitles.en: And that has, of course, an effect to that some of these AI-related companies they've very domestically focused on revenues.

subtitles.zh: 所有这些都影响着基本面上行趋势的可持续性，目前来看动力不足。
subtitles.en: And all that sort of plays a role on how sustainable basically that upward trend is, which at the moment said it's not much there.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们可能需要更好的增长、更好的消息面来释放我们实际看到的价值。
subtitles.en: And so we probably need just better growth, better news flow to unlock that value that we actually see.

subtitles.zh: 现在我应该如何为第四季度构建我的**组合？
subtitles.en: How should I frame my portfolio for the fourth quarter now, right?

briefs.speaker: Kenja Lao
briefs.speaker_context: Goldman Sachs, Chief China Equity Strategist
briefs.current_title: 高盛首席中国策略师：估值已触底？盈利拐点将至！

subtitles.zh: 你认为估值已经触底了吗？
subtitles.en: Do you think we've reached a floor when it comes to valuations yet?

subtitles.zh: 我认为是的。以MSCI中国指数为基准，看最新数据。
subtitles.en: I would say so. Okay. So if you look at the latest number that we have, well, we look at MSI China as a benchmark.

subtitles.zh: 目前市场前瞻市盈率约为9倍。
subtitles.en: So right now the market is trading on about nine times forward earnings.

subtitles.zh: 但回顾过去二十年，我们基本回到了2024年9月前的低谷。
subtitles.en: But if you go back to the past two decades of history, essentially we are back to the trough pre September 2024.

subtitles.zh: 显然，2024年9月我们迎来了所谓的积极转折。
subtitles.en: And obviously in September 2020-04 we had the so-called positive pivot.

subtitles.zh: 另一个重要变量当然是盈利预期。
subtitles.en: So the very important, the other very important moving part here is of course our earnings expectations.

subtitles.zh: 以及中国权益资产如何向股东兑现盈利。
subtitles.en: And how Chinese equities have been delivering earnings to shareholders.

subtitles.zh: 两三年前，盈利状况相当低迷。
subtitles.en: Now, three years ago, two years ago, the earnings picture was pretty down bit.

subtitles.zh: 但如今，即便我们预期低于市场共识，整体市场盈利预计增长约10%。
subtitles.en: But now, even with our below consensus expectations on earnings, with expecting earnings to grow about 10% for the overall market.

subtitles.zh: 你们看到盈利表现如何？盈利广度怎样？
subtitles.en: Are you seeing earnings being, what is the earnings breadth?

subtitles.zh: 是主要集中在国企，还是看到它向其他市场扩散？
subtitles.en: Is it concentrated mainly in the SOE's or are you seeing it broadening out to the rest of the markets?

briefs.speaker: Kenja Lao
briefs.speaker_context: Goldman Sachs, Chief China Equity Strategist
briefs.current_title: 高盛：AI驱动盈利增长，互联网板块即将修复？

subtitles.zh: 所以这样看，总体而言，AI显然持续是中国权益资产整体盈利增长的重要驱动力。
subtitles.en: So with this way, I think broadly speaking, obviously AI has continued to be a very important drive of earnings growth for the aggregate Chinese equity market.

subtitles.zh: 尤其是看上半年数据，比如内地市场，利润增速高达20%。
subtitles.en: So particularly when you look at the first half numbers, China A, for example, delivered up to 20% profit growth.

subtitles.zh: 这是过去三四年来的最高水平。
subtitles.en: And that was the highest in the past three, four years.

subtitles.zh: 显然，鉴于市场关注度，内地市场非常受益于AI热潮，无论美国还是国内。
subtitles.en: And obviously given the interest conversation, obviously China A is very much benefiting from the AI boom, whether it's in the US or within China.

subtitles.zh: 目前，盈利表现拖累或落后的领域显然是互联网公司。
subtitles.en: Now, I think the drag or the areas that have been underperforming into earnings delivery, obviously, is the internet companies.

subtitles.zh: 但我们预计，在约两三周后的 upcoming 财报季，互联网行业盈利增长有望出现复苏前兆。
subtitles.en: But we have an expectation that in the upcoming resource season, which will happen in about two or three weeks, we think that would likely see in pre-meaning for recovery of earnings growth for the internet sector.

briefs.speaker: Kenja Lao
briefs.speaker_context: Goldman Sachs, Chief China Equity Strategist
briefs.current_title: 高盛：贸易摩擦升温，中国如何寻找新平衡？

subtitles.zh: 因为刚有报道称，欧盟正考虑对化工、家具等其他行业的中国进口商品设置新上限。
subtitles.en: Because we just reported that the EU is now looking at potential new caps on Chinese imports in other sectors like chemicals, furnitures.

subtitles.zh: 这会如何反映在市场？我认为这将继续是权益资产参与者的一大担忧。
subtitles.en: How is that going to show up in markets? I think that will continue to be a concern for equity investors.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为重要的是退一步，思考这里的整体动态。
subtitles.en: But I think it's important to really take a step back and think about the whole dynamic here.

subtitles.zh: 显然，欧盟可以施加更多限制或贸易关税。
subtitles.en: Obviously, the EU can put in more restrictions or trade tariffs.

subtitles.zh: 但与此同时，我认为中国在法律体系层面有相当好的筹码，对吧？
subtitles.en: But at the same time, I think China has a pretty good leverage on the legal system table, right?

subtitles.zh: 尤其是稀土。所以我认为双方需要继续接触，真正得出结论，在贸易关系上找到新的平衡。
subtitles.en: In particular, rare earths. So that's why I think the two parties need to continue to engage and really come to an conclusion in trying to find a new equilibrium when it comes to trade relationships.

subtitles.zh: 好的，谢谢。请继续关注。稍后我们将继续对话高盛首席中国权益资产策略师Kenja Lao。
subtitles.en: All right, thanks. Stay with us. We'll have more with Kenja Lao, Chief China Equity Strategist at Goldman Sachs.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Forbidden hard-negative wording: 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not use sensitive geopolitical or military subjects, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbered prefixes.
- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

      "高盛",

      "互联网板块修复在即？"
    ],
    "current_comment": "",
    "subtitles": [
      {
        "index": 1,
        "zh": "所以这样看，总体而言，AI显然持续是中国权益资产整体盈利增长的重要驱动力。",
        "en": "So with this way, I think broadly speaking, obviously AI has continued to be a very important drive of earnings growth for the aggregate Chinese equity market.",
        "relative_start": 0.0,
        "relative_end": 10.0
      },
      {
        "index": 2,
        "zh": "尤其是看上半年数据，比如内地市场，利润增速高达20%。",
        "en": "So particularly when you look at the first half numbers, China A, for example, delivered up to 20% profit growth.",
        "relative_start": 10.0,
        "relative_end": 17.0
      },
      {
        "index": 3,
        "zh": "这是过去三四年来的最高水平。",
        "en": "And that was the highest in the past three, four years.",
        "relative_start": 17.0,
        "relative_end": 21.0
      },
      {
        "index": 4,
        "zh": "显然，鉴于市场关注度，内地市场非常受益于AI热潮，无论美国还是国内。",
        "en": "And obviously given the interest conversation, obviously China A is very much benefiting from the AI boom, whether it's in the US or within China.",
        "relative_start": 21.0,
        "relative_end": 32.0
      },
      {
        "index": 5,
        "zh": "目前，盈利表现拖累或落后的领域显然是互联网公司。",
        "en": "Now, I think the drag or the areas that have been underperforming into earnings delivery, obviously, is the internet companies.",
        "relative_start": 32.0,
        "relative_end": 41.0
      },
      {
        "index": 6,
        "zh": "但我们预计，在约两三周后的 upcoming 财报季，互联网行业盈利增长有望出现复苏前兆。",
        "en": "But we have an expectation that in the upcoming resource season, which will happen in about two or three weeks, we think that would likely see in pre-meaning for recovery of earnings growth for the internet sector.",
        "relative_start": 41.0,
        "relative_end": 52.0
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "index": 12,
    "duration_seconds": 48.7,
    "speaker": "Kenja Lao",
    "speaker_context": "Goldman Sachs, Chief China Equity Strategist",
    "source_title": "",
    "show_date": "2026-10-27",
    "current_title": "高盛：贸易摩擦升温，中国如何寻找新平衡？",
    "current_title_lines": [
      "高盛",
      "贸易摩擦升温",
      "中国如何寻找新平衡？"
    ],
    "current_comment": "",
    "subtitles": [
      {
        "index": 1,
        "zh": "因为刚有报道称，欧盟正考虑对化工、家具等其他行业的中国进口商品设置新上限。",
        "en": "Because we just reported that the EU is now looking at potential new caps on Chinese imports in other sectors like chemicals, furnitures.",
        "relative_start": 0.0,
        "relative_end": 9.0
      },
      {
        "index": 2,
        "zh": "这会如何反映在市场？我认为这将继续是权益资产参与者的一大担忧。",
        "en": "How is that going to show up in markets? I think that will continue to be a concern for equity investors.",
        "relative_start": 9.0,
        "relative_end": 15.0
      },
      {
        "index": 3,
        "zh": "但我认为重要的是退一步，思考这里的整体动态。",
        "en": "But I think it's important to really take a step back and think about the whole dynamic here.",
        "relative_start": 15.0,
        "relative_end": 20.0
      },
      {
        "index": 4,
        "zh": "显然，欧盟可以施加更多限制或贸易关税。",
        "en": "Obviously, the EU can put in more restrictions or trade tariffs.",
        "relative_start": 21.0,
        "relative_end": 28.0
      },
      {
        "index": 5,
        "zh": "但与此同时，我认为中国在法律体系层面有相当好的筹码，对吧？",
        "en": "But at the same time, I think China has a pretty good leverage on the legal system table, right?",
        "relative_start": 28.0,
        "relative_end": 34.0
      },
      {
        "index": 6,
        "zh": "尤其是稀土。所以我认为双方需要继续接触，真正得出结论，在贸易关系上找到新的平衡。",
        "en": "In particular, rare earths. So that's why I think the two parties need to continue to engage and really come to an conclusion in trying to find a new equilibrium when it comes to trade relationships.",
        "relative_start": 34.0,
        "relative_end": 43.0
      },
      {
        "index": 7,
        "zh": "好的，谢谢。请继续关注。稍后我们将继续对话高盛首席中国权益资产策略师Kenja Lao。",
        "en": "All right, thanks. Stay with us. We'll have more with Kenja Lao, Chief China Equity Strategist at Goldman Sachs.",
        "relative_start": 44.0,
        "relative_end": 48.7
      }
    ]
  }
]

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.

- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.

briefs.speaker: Kendra Lau
briefs.speaker_context: Chief China equity strategist at Goldman Sachs
briefs.current_title: 高盛Kendra Lau：中美利差罕见倒挂，银行板块为何成避风港？

subtitles.zh: 你大幅超配银行，对保险则中性。谈谈背后的思路。我认为大背景是，我们正看到相当显著且前所未有的情况：美国利率与中国利率走势分化。
subtitles.en: You've owned way in the banks. You neutralize the insurers. Tell us a little more about the thinking behind that. Well, I think the big picture here is that we are seeing a pretty significant and quite unprecedented situation where US rates

subtitles.zh: 所以提到美国10年期国债收益率现在约在5%以上。
subtitles.en: are diverging. So you talk about 10-year bond news in the US now above around 5 percent.

subtitles.zh: 但同时，中国10年期国债收益率现在在1.6%。
subtitles.en: But at the same time, Chinese bond news, 10-year bond news, and now at 1.6.

subtitles.zh: 而两者利差超过3.5个百分点，历史上从未见过。
subtitles.en: And the UGAPs is above 3.5 percentage point. We've never seen that before in history.

subtitles.zh: 在此背景下，我们认为这主要反映了几个因素。
subtitles.en: So against the backdrop, we think that essentially that reflects a few things.

subtitles.zh: 第一，全球两大经济体在增长和通胀预期上的差异。
subtitles.en: Number one is the growth and inflation expectations, differentials between the two major economies in the world.

subtitles.zh: 将其转化为权益市场策略，我们认为银行表现应会不错。
subtitles.en: And when you translate that into equity market strategy, we think that banks should do well.

subtitles.zh: 尤其是香港上市的中资银行。原因一：美国利率高企时，人们寻求价值。
subtitles.en: Particularly Hong Kong listed Chinese banks. The reasons are number one. When rates are high in the US, people look for value.

subtitles.zh: 在香港寻找股息机会，银行显然应受益。
subtitles.en: Look for dividend plays in Hong Kong. And obviously banks should benefit.

subtitles.zh: 同时，内地利率1.6%意味着内地市场股权风险溢价仍处高位。
subtitles.en: And at the same time, when you look at onshore rates, 1.6 percent, that implies that equity risk premium remains very elevated in the onshore market.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为这可能会为短久期权益资产和银行板块提供一定支撑，而银行也属于这一类别。
subtitles.en: And we think that we'll likely provide some support for short-duration equities and banks with fit into that category.

briefs.speaker: Kendra Lau
briefs.speaker_context: Chief China equity strategist at Goldman Sachs
briefs.current_title: 高盛Kendra Lau：盈利拐点已现，市场为何不买账？

subtitles.zh: 我们认为这可能为短久期权益资产和银行板块提供一定支撑。您能否解释一下，鉴于报告提到我们正接近盈利拐点。
subtitles.en: And we think that we'll likely provide some support for short-duration equities and banks with fit into that category. Can you explain why is it that, given you said in your report, we are closed to this earnings inflection point.

subtitles.zh: 您提到第二季度有20%的涨幅，是五年来的最高水平。
subtitles.en: I mean, second quarter, you mentioned, is 20 percent gain, which is the highest in five years.

subtitles.zh: 而我们刚看到的工业企业利润数据也出现了较大幅度跃升。
subtitles.en: And we just got the industrial profit numbers, which is quite a big jump.

subtitles.zh: 是的，我们持续看到市场反应与数据似乎有些脱节。
subtitles.en: And yes, we continue to see the market reaction, looking pretty like last, but there seems to be a disconnect there.

subtitles.zh: 这是怎么回事？如果看市场内部结构，本质上银行、现金回报主题和股息策略表现不错。
subtitles.en: What is going on? I mean, if you look at the internal of the markets, essentially again, banks, or cash return themes, dividends, they've done well.

subtitles.zh: 但明显承压的领域是权益市场中与AI相关的部分。
subtitles.en: But the areas that are seeing some pressure, obviously, is the AI part of the economy in the equity market.

subtitles.zh: 正如我们与Yvonne讨论时，我提出了那个问题。
subtitles.en: And I think, as we discussed with Yvonne, I asked that question.

subtitles.zh: 我认为目前全球beta对AI科技板块仍是拖累。
subtitles.en: I think the global beta remains a drag for the AI tech for now.

subtitles.zh: 所以退一步看，如果观察综合指数，目前估值已回到非常有吸引力的水平。
subtitles.en: So when you kind of take a step back, if you look at the aggregate index, right now, valuations are back to very attractive levels.

subtitles.zh: 正如您提到的，国家队正在加大力度、介入市场，对吗？
subtitles.en: As you mentioned, that the national team is stepping up, stepping in, right?

subtitles.zh: 据我们估算，仅过去两周，国家队净买入约2000亿港元的亚洲权益资产。
subtitles.en: And on our estimate, just in the past two weeks, national team has net bought about 200 billion worth of Asia equities.

subtitles.zh: 因此我们认为，短期内流动性和情绪可能获得支撑，Alice。
subtitles.en: So we think that we're likely to pull a floor, Alice, in the short term, when it comes to liquidity and sentiment.

briefs.speaker: Kendra Lau
briefs.speaker_context: Chief China equity strategist at Goldman Sachs
briefs.current_title: 高盛Kendra Lau：AI组合大调整，硬件之后应用接棒？

subtitles.zh: 所以，Alice，我们认为短期内流动性和情绪可能见底。你也更新了中国精选AI组合。
subtitles.en: So we think that we're likely to pull a floor, Alice, in the short term, when it comes to liquidity and sentiment. You also refreshed your China Select AI portfolio.

subtitles.zh: 你是怎么更新的？硬件还是重要主题吗？那个组合里？
subtitles.en: How did you refresh it? Is hardware still a big theme? Isn't that portfolio?

subtitles.zh: 我觉得关键词其实是多元化。
subtitles.en: I think the key word here is really diversification.

subtitles.zh: 很抱歉这么说，但我听了Anthony刚才讲的中国AI生态加速发展。
subtitles.en: Sorry to say that, but I listened to what Anthony just talked about in terms of the Chinese AI ecosystem ramping up.

subtitles.zh: 所以在我们几周前发布的一份报告中，我们确实试图强调这个主题。
subtitles.en: So in a report that we put out a few weeks ago, essentially, we really tried to emphasize on that subject.

subtitles.zh: 我认为全球AI共识的叙事肯定在市场参与者中越来越有吸引力。
subtitles.en: I think the narrative of a global AI deal openly is definitely gaining traction among investors.

subtitles.zh: 所以当你审视中国AI生态时，实际上有两个部分。
subtitles.en: So when you look at the Chinese AI ecosystem, actually, there are two parts of the ecosystem.

subtitles.zh: 一部分更偏向出口导向。也就是中国AI公司把产品出口到西方，对吧？
subtitles.en: One is more export oriented. So Chinese AI companies that are exporting the products to the West, right?

subtitles.zh: 所以它们基本上是美国资本开支繁荣的衍生品。
subtitles.en: So they're basically derivatives of the CapEx boom in the US.

subtitles.zh: 但同时，另一个主要部分是中国AI公司主要服务内地市场。
subtitles.en: But at the same time, the other major part of the picture is really the Chinese AI companies primarily serving the domestic market.

subtitles.zh: 他们对外出口并不多，业务主要在国内。
subtitles.en: They don't really export that much to the world, but they really do their business on shore.

subtitles.zh: 因此我们构建了两个不同的组合，帮助市场参与者更好地布局未来这一趋势。
subtitles.en: So that's why we create two different baskets to help investors better position for that development in the future.

subtitles.zh: 我们仍看好出口型企业，但同时，如果市场参与者想把握AI生态内更独特的机会，
subtitles.en: So we still like the exporters, but at the same time, I think if investors want to really trade for the more idiosyncratic opportunities within the AI ecosystem,

subtitles.zh: 我认为本土企业将从中受益。
subtitles.en: I think the domestic names would benefit that.

briefs.speaker: Kendra Lau
briefs.speaker_context: Chief China equity strategist at Goldman Sachs
briefs.current_title: 高盛Kendra Lau：中美AI路径分化，中国应用端机会在哪？

subtitles.zh: 那同行AI表现如何？它们受到较大冲击，对吧？
subtitles.en: What about the peer play AI? They've been hit quite hard, right?

subtitles.zh: 因为它们在技术上不如美国先进。
subtitles.en: Because they're not as technology advanced as the US.

subtitles.zh: 你还有像DeepSeek这样的公司似乎仍在领跑，但它们尚未上市。
subtitles.en: You still have the likes of deep-seek that seem to be still leading the charge that are not listed companies yet.

subtitles.zh: 这就让像智谱、MiniMax这样的公司处于一种悬而未决的状态。
subtitles.en: And that really kind of leaves the likes of Jirupu, the likes of Mini Max, and kind of a limbo there.

subtitles.zh: 它们只是有点落后。我该如何看待同行表现？
subtitles.en: They're just kind of just dragging behind me. How should I look at peer plays?

subtitles.zh: 我会说我们看看美国。
subtitles.en: I would say we look at the US.

subtitles.zh: 我认为基本上，美国和中国在发展AI方面采取了非常不同的方式。
subtitles.en: I think basically, US and China are taking very different approaches when it comes to developing AI.

subtitles.zh: 显然，在美国，这更像是一种高成本、高回报的模式。
subtitles.en: Obviously, in the US, it's more like a high cost and properly high return model.

subtitles.zh: 例如，其他领先公司正试图创造AGI、ASI。
subtitles.en: For example, again, other leading companies are trying to create AGI ASI.

subtitles.zh: 但对中国来说，我认为AI被视为一种公共产品。
subtitles.en: But for China, I think AI is perceived or regarded as a public good.

subtitles.zh: 这就是为什么我们有开源模型、开放权重模型。
subtitles.en: That's why we have open source model, open weight model.

subtitles.zh: 你基本上不是靠收取高利润率来赚钱。
subtitles.en: You don't make money basically charging very high margins.

subtitles.zh: 而是靠规模来赚钱。
subtitles.en: But you make money from volume.

subtitles.zh: 所以每当政策制定者谈到人工智能时，都会带一个加号。
subtitles.en: So when it comes to trying that every time policymakers talk about AI, it comes with a plus.

subtitles.zh: 就是人工智能加应用。
subtitles.en: It's AI plus application.

subtitles.zh: 所以这就是为什么在我们的报告中，我们真正试图强调，除了硬件板块，我们认为应用可能是发展方向。
subtitles.en: So that's why in our report, we really try to emphasize, besides the hardware cohorts, we think that applications could be the way to go.

subtitles.zh: 我们看到它非常契合AI周期。欧洲则稍显吃力。
subtitles.en: We can see it fits very well into the AI cycle. Europe struggles a bit more.

subtitles.zh: 但我们也开始看到，整体信贷利差出现了一些代价。
subtitles.en: But we also can start to see that there's some tolls now on credit spreads overall.

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，美国高收益利差达到年内最阔水平。
subtitles.en: I mean, U.S. high yield spreads are that widest for the year.

subtitles.zh: 这可能也与为整个AI**提供资金所需的部分融资有关。
subtitles.en: And it's probably also related on some of the funding that it's needed to basically finance the whole AI investments.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们开始看到一些裂痕出现，或者对其可持续性、能持续多久存在问号。
subtitles.en: And so, we start to see that there's some cracks coming up and or question marks on how sustainable it is, how long it can go.

subtitles.zh: 但总体而言，我们仍对该主题非常乐观。
subtitles.en: But overall, we still remain very positive on the topic.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我认为还有更多上行空间。
subtitles.en: And therefore, I think there's more upside.

subtitles.zh: 鉴于台积电等公司的可靠性和吸引力，请告诉我们今天台湾的情况。
subtitles.en: Given how reliable and anthropic is on companies like TSMC, just tell us what's going on in Taiwan today.

subtitles.zh: 为什么它没有太大变动？嗯，我认为我们应该，我的意思是，它也已经关闭了。
subtitles.en: Why is it not really moving that much? Well, I think we should, I mean, it was closed as well.

subtitles.zh: 我们已经看到，科技和半导体板块出现了调整，尤其是在过去几周。
subtitles.en: We have seen, there was a correction on tech and semiconductors name, particularly over the last couple of weeks as well.

subtitles.zh: 财报季非常积极。我们看到了28%的盈利增长，尤其是来自人工智能部分。
subtitles.en: The earnings season is very positive. We have 28% earnings growth, particularly from the AI part.

subtitles.zh: 而人工智能盈利的一半实际上来自半导体。
subtitles.en: And half of the AI earnings are actually coming from semiconductors.

subtitles.zh: 所以，势头非常好。但我认为市场参与者也希望具体看到数字，而且2028年之后仍有一个问号，会发生什么。
subtitles.en: So, it's a very good momentum. But I think investors also want to really have the numbers concretely and there's still a question mark beyond 2028, what will happen.

subtitles.zh: 我认为，这可能是部分市场参与者重新配置的环节。
subtitles.en: And I think that's sort of the part where some investors may reposition themselves.

subtitles.zh: 正如我们也在台湾所做的那样。资本成本一直是市场担忧的大事，担心它是否会以任何方式破坏这轮人工智能热潮。
subtitles.en: As we also did, particularly in Taiwan. The cost of capital, that was always the big thing that was worrying the market on whether it would derail this AI boom in any way.

briefs.speaker: Adrian Zuercher
briefs.speaker_context: UBS Chief Investment Office — Co-head Global Asset Allocation and Co-head of Global Investment Management for APAC
briefs.current_title: 瑞银Adrian：融资成本上升，AI交易最大隐患？

subtitles.zh: 您认为融资成本上升是否仍会对AI交易构成某种压力？
subtitles.en: Do you think that when it comes to higher financing costs, is that going to be still some sort of overhang when it comes to the AI trade?

subtitles.zh: 目前这些公司根本不在意多发50个基点。
subtitles.en: Well, at the moment, these companies, they just don't care if they issue at 50 base points more.

subtitles.zh: 这也开始对政府债券产生一定的挤出效应。
subtitles.en: And we started a little bit of a crowding out also for government bonds.

subtitles.zh: 因此对超额利差产生了影响。
subtitles.en: And so it had an impact on overrun spreads.

subtitles.zh: 也对超额利率产生了影响。现在，作为多资产类别市场参与者，当利率和债券开始真正显得有吸引力时，
subtitles.en: And it had an impact overrun rates. Now, as a multi-asset class investor, after, say, rates and bonds really start to look attractive,

subtitles.zh: 一个优质债券组合的年化收益率可能达到6%。
subtitles.en: you get probably 6% per annum yield on a good quality bond portfolio.

subtitles.zh: 这是简单的数学。如果以6%的收益率**五年，平均而言，通常每年至少能获得6%的回报。
subtitles.en: And it's just simple math. If you invest at the yield of six in five years in average, usually you will probably clock in at least 6% return per annum.

subtitles.zh: 考虑到所承担的风险水平，这相当有吸引力。
subtitles.en: And that's quite attractive for the risk level you take.

subtitles.zh: 当然，短期来看，我们仍认为权益资产还有一定上行空间。
subtitles.en: Short term, of course, we still think equities have a bit more upside.

subtitles.zh: 但如果以10年为基准来看，我们刚刚做了相关研究。
subtitles.en: But if you look on a 10-year basis, we just did our research there.

subtitles.zh: 债券表现实际上优于权益资产。
subtitles.en: Bonds are actually outperforming equities.

subtitles.zh: 一旦权益风险溢价归零，优质**级组合收益率达到6%至6.5%左右。
subtitles.en: Once you have sort of a equities risk premium at zero, once you have yielded around six at six and a half on a good investment grade portfolio.

subtitles.zh: 因此，权益资产或债券的长期逻辑受到一定影响。
subtitles.en: So the long-term case for equities or bonds has been a bit more compromised.

subtitles.zh: 但短期来看，我认为两者都有不错的上行空间。
subtitles.en: But short term, I think both have a nice upside now.

subtitles.zh: 你对中国科技板块有多乐观？
subtitles.en: How constructive are you in Chinese tech?

briefs.speaker: Adrian Zuercher
briefs.speaker_context: UBS Chief Investment Office — Co-head Global Asset Allocation and Co-head of Global Investment Management for APAC
briefs.current_title: 瑞银Adrian：中国科技估值诱人，但催化剂在哪？

subtitles.zh: 你对中国科技板块有多乐观？因为Cambricorn要发布财报，还有CXMT。
subtitles.en: How constructive are you in Chinese tech? Because we have Cambricorn releasing earnings, misestimates, CXMT.

subtitles.zh: 这是增长季度，预计环比也持平。
subtitles.en: It's growth quarter and quarter expected to remain flat as well.

subtitles.zh: 那么你认为有潜力吗？有理由持有中国科技股吗？
subtitles.en: So do you see any potential, any reason to hold Chinese tech?

subtitles.zh: 理由是估值。但我们现在对中国科技板块也更谨慎一些。
subtitles.en: The reason is valuation. But we also have been a bit more cautious now on Chinese tech.

subtitles.zh: 而且，中国整体增长面临压力。
subtitles.en: And look, Chinese is struggling in terms of growth overall.

subtitles.zh: **周期相当疲弱。我的意思是，出口是唯一真正有效的。
subtitles.en: Investment cycle is quite weak. I mean, the export is the one thing that really works.

subtitles.zh: 但这些**大多是国内的。
subtitles.en: But most of these investments are really domestic.

subtitles.zh: 我认为人工智能能力方面有很好的故事，但还没有体现出来。
subtitles.en: And I think there's a very good story around AI capabilities, but it's sort of not coming through.

subtitles.zh: 需要催化剂来释放这一点。目前很难看到这个催化剂。
subtitles.en: And it's a catalyst to unlock that. And it's very hard to see at the moment this catalyst.

subtitles.zh: 所以如果你有较长远的眼光，是的，配置一些中国人工智能资产是好的。
subtitles.en: So if you have a bit of a longer-term vision, yeah, it's good to have some Chinese AI exposure.

subtitles.zh: 但作为战术性交易，目前可能还不够。
subtitles.en: But for a tactical trade, it probably at the moment not enough.

subtitles.zh: 那么催化剂会是什么？
subtitles.en: What's going to be that catalyst, though?

briefs.speaker: Kenja Lao
briefs.speaker_context: Goldman Sachs, Chief China Equity Strategist
briefs.current_title: 高盛：AI驱动盈利增长，互联网板块即将修复？

subtitles.zh: 所以这样看，总体而言，AI显然持续是中国权益资产整体盈利增长的重要驱动力。
subtitles.en: So with this way, I think broadly speaking, obviously AI has continued to be a very important drive of earnings growth for the aggregate Chinese equity market.

subtitles.zh: 尤其是看上半年数据，比如内地市场，利润增速高达20%。
subtitles.en: So particularly when you look at the first half numbers, China A, for example, delivered up to 20% profit growth.

subtitles.zh: 这是过去三四年来的最高水平。
subtitles.en: And that was the highest in the past three, four years.

subtitles.zh: 显然，鉴于市场关注度，内地市场非常受益于AI热潮，无论美国还是国内。
subtitles.en: And obviously given the interest conversation, obviously China A is very much benefiting from the AI boom, whether it's in the US or within China.

subtitles.zh: 目前，盈利表现拖累或落后的领域显然是互联网公司。
subtitles.en: Now, I think the drag or the areas that have been underperforming into earnings delivery, obviously, is the internet companies.

subtitles.zh: 但我们预计，在约两三周后的 upcoming 财报季，互联网行业盈利增长有望出现复苏前兆。
subtitles.en: But we have an expectation that in the upcoming resource season, which will happen in about two or three weeks, we think that would likely see in pre-meaning for recovery of earnings growth for the internet sector.

briefs.speaker: Kenja Lao
briefs.speaker_context: Goldman Sachs, Chief China Equity Strategist
briefs.current_title: 高盛：贸易摩擦升温，中国如何寻找新平衡？

subtitles.zh: 因为刚有报道称，欧盟正考虑对化工、家具等其他行业的中国进口商品设置新上限。
subtitles.en: Because we just reported that the EU is now looking at potential new caps on Chinese imports in other sectors like chemicals, furnitures.

subtitles.zh: 这会如何反映在市场？我认为这将继续是权益资产参与者的一大担忧。
subtitles.en: How is that going to show up in markets? I think that will continue to be a concern for equity investors.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为重要的是退一步，思考这里的整体动态。
subtitles.en: But I think it's important to really take a step back and think about the whole dynamic here.

subtitles.zh: 显然，欧盟可以施加更多限制或贸易关税。
subtitles.en: Obviously, the EU can put in more restrictions or trade tariffs.

subtitles.zh: 但与此同时，我认为中国在法律体系层面有相当好的筹码，对吧？
subtitles.en: But at the same time, I think China has a pretty good leverage on the legal system table, right?

subtitles.zh: 尤其是稀土。所以我认为双方需要继续接触，真正得出结论，在贸易关系上找到新的平衡。
subtitles.en: In particular, rare earths. So that's why I think the two parties need to continue to engage and really come to an conclusion in trying to find a new equilibrium when it comes to trade relationships.

subtitles.zh: 好的，谢谢。请继续关注。稍后我们将继续对话高盛首席中国权益资产策略师Kenja Lao。
subtitles.en: All right, thanks. Stay with us. We'll have more with Kenja Lao, Chief China Equity Strategist at Goldman Sachs.
